94.stem:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are

numbered A, B, C and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and

A. He looked; there were two bags of gold.
B. When he came to himself, on the third day, he looked long at all the corners of his hut but in vain did
he endeavour to recollect what had taken place; his memory was like a miser's pocket from which you
cannot entice a quarter of a kopek.
C. Stretching himself, he heard something clash at his feet.

had frightened him in the woods.
S2 But at what price he had obtained it, and how, he could by no means tell.

94.explanation: B describes Peter awakening and failing to recall events, followed by C (sound), A (gold), D (recollection), so B–C–A–D.
